title: Broken Ground
subtitle: Mission 2 · 2 vs 2 · about 50 minutes
coachNotes: New lances: each side gets one jumper and one fast ’Mech. Same cards as Ridge Line, new partners.
Partial cover: if a hill crest or wall hides the bottom half of the target from the shooter, turn on Partial cover in the shot. It makes the shot 1 harder.
Rear shots: if the attack comes in through the rear of the target’s base, turn on Rear hit. A hit does 1 extra damage, so keep your back away from enemies.
Jumping lets a ’Mech hop straight over woods and hills. The jumper is harder to hit, but its own shot is harder too.
Standing still makes your own shot 1 easier. Behind cover, that can be worth it.
Still no overheating and no punching. Those come in later missions.
tableSteps: Use the same open table, about 3 feet across. Measure in inches and ignore printed hexes.
Put a hill in the middle third: a book under a cloth, or the hill side of a map. House rule for this mission: climbing costs no extra inches (the full rules charge extra).
Add a low wall or rock line on each side of the hill. Anything that hides a ’Mech’s legs counts as partial cover.
Add two patches of woods, one on each half of the table. Woods work like Ridge Line.
Each side places its two ’Mechs within 6 inches of its own short table edge. After the first dice roll, the winner picks which side places first; then take turns placing one ’Mech at a time.
winningSummary: Knock out both enemy ’Mechs. If anyone is still standing after 8 turns, the side with more Structure left wins. Same Structure is a draw. The turn limit is a Mech Buddy rule; the rulebook has none.

layout.openTable: No maps? Any open table about 36 × 22 inches works. Add the terrain where the diagram shows it.
